title: Relief on the Arrears Rate Where the Member's Grain Business Stands Behind the Balance
content:
A member who settles grain through the cooperative brings the energy balance a measure of security, and the rate the arrears bear on an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts is relieved accordingly. The settlements issued on the member's Grain Marketing Contracts and the gallons still owed to the member out of a pre-buy decide the line.

1. Where the grain settlements issued to the member over the twelve months ending on the handling date reach 25000 USD and the gallons still owed to the member out of a pre-buy reach the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons, the rate the arrears bear is the programme's monthly service charge less 0.35 of a percentage point.
2. Where those grain settlements reach 25000 USD and the gallons still owed to the member out of a pre-buy fall under the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons, the rate the arrears bear is the programme's monthly service charge less 0.15 of a percentage point.
3. Where those grain settlements fall under 25000 USD, the rate the arrears bear is the programme's monthly service charge, with no relief.

## What the two readings are

The settlement figure is the net money of the settlement statements issued to the member under their Grain Marketing Contracts over the twelve months ending on the handling date. The gallons figure is the gallons still owed to the member out of a pre-buy as the energy account carries it, measured against the minimum pre-buy gallons the catalogue writes for the programme.

| Grain settlements issued in the window | Gallons still owed out of a pre-buy | Rate the arrears bear |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 25000 USD or more | At or above the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons | The programme's monthly service charge, less 0.35 |
| 25000 USD or more | Below the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons | The programme's monthly service charge, less 0.15 |
| Under 25000 USD | Either way | The programme's monthly service charge |

*Hypothetical.* On a programme whose monthly service charge is 1.5 percent and whose minimum pre-buy gallons stand at 1000, a member with 26000.00 USD of grain settlements in the window and 1000.0 gallons still owed out of a pre-buy bears 1.15 percent a month. The same member with 900.0 gallons still owed bears 1.35 percent a month. At 24000.00 USD of settlements, the rate is 1.5 percent a month on either gallon figure.
